## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant automated checks and Windows behaviors exercised. State any acceptance checks still pending. If a local run omitted native clipboard verification, state that explicitly; CI must run the full suite.

## Visual or data impact

Include a screenshot for visual changes and identify static renders versus native captures. Describe any new data access or retention, opt-in and disconnect behavior, and offline/unavailable states. Use synthetic examples and exclude personal clipboard, calendar, notification, AI, and download content.
